newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria, France agree debt settlement.
newsitem.headline: Syria, France agree debt settlement.

text.p: France and Syria reached agreement on Sunday on a rescheduling of Syria's 1.8 billion franc ($350 million) debt to Paris, opening the way for an expansion of economic relations, French officials said.
They said ministers would sign the deal later in the day, ending more than a decade of dispute that stopped French financial aid and export credit guarantees to Damascus.
The officials said the sum consisted of 800 million francs in principal and interest and one billion francs in arrears.

Presidents Jacques Chirac and Hafez al-Assad will hold an unscheduled extra session of talks on Sunday night to discuss new bilateral economic and cultural projects following the debt deal, the officials said. ($1 = 5.2 French Francs)
